title: Crash when editor exits while a script is awaiting
body:
### Tested versions

4.7 beta3

### System information

W10

### Issue description

I recently encountered project crashes when exporting ([again xd](https://github.com/godotengine/godot/issues/105327)). It happens on GDScript cleanup, but in a very specific case caused by my addon. I have a script that creates some icons in `_static_init()` using a viewport and awaiting `frame_post_draw`. If that code runs during project export, the editor crashes on exit

It's probably not related to export itself, but any cmdline tool ran in headless mode. The crash seems to happen because the GDScript instance is doing cleanup after the GDScriptLanguage has been freed, so the singleton here is null
https://github.com/godotengine/godot/blob/e82870e250a326c94e03d658306db94e1b116c2d/modules/gdscript/gdscript.cpp#L1488
Fixing it might be as simple as checking the singleton exists, but it's more likely that destruction order is wrong or something.

### Steps to reproduce

Run `godot.exe --headless --export-debug Windows` in the MRP.

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[crash_of_the_end.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/28367208/crash_of_the_end.zip)
